title: Old Ying Shan
summary: The Black Emperor Sect picks Xiao Yan's Zong Breaking Pill over the other bids, and Xiao Yan wins the Bodhisattva Body Transformation Saliva. Old Ying Shan, an old Dou Zong, snatches it and flees the city, and every faction chases him. Fang Yan, First Elder of Demon Flame Valley, offers Xiao Yan help, and Xiao Yan turns him down. Xiao Yan meets Su Qian and Xiao Li, drops his disguise, and they agree to help him get the saliva back for Little Fairy Doctor. Old Ying Shan's decoys turn out to be clones, and Xiao Yan tracks down the real one, who is facing Mo Tian Xing. Fang Yan arrives, reveals that Yan Xiao is Xiao Yan, chief of the Xiao Gate, and brings in the gray-robed man.
events: The Black Emperor Sect accepts Xiao Yan's Zong Breaking Pill
Old Ying Shan snatches the saliva and flees
Fang Yan offers Demon Flame Valley's help; Xiao Yan refuses
Xiao Yan reunites with Su Qian and Xiao Li and explains the Woeful Poison Body
The group beats four of Old Ying Shan's clones
Mo Tian Xing corners the real Old Ying Shan
Fang Yan reveals Xiao Yan's identity and the gray-robed man shows his face
cultivation: Old Ying Shan is a Dou Zong. Xiao Yan tells Xiao Li he trained in seclusion for a year to become a Dou Huang.
